units.zh: 樂毅者，其先祖曰樂羊。
units.en: Yue Yi's ancestor was called Yue Yang.
units.literal: Yue Yi, his ancestor called Yue Yang.

units.zh: 樂羊為魏文侯將，伐取中山，魏文侯封樂羊以靈壽。
units.en: Yue Yang was a general under Marquis Wen of Wei. After he attacked and captured Zhongshan, Marquis Wen enfeoffed him at Lingshou.
units.literal: Yue Yang served as general for Marquis Wen of Wei, attacked and took Zhongshan, and Marquis Wen of Wei enfeoffed Yue Yang at Lingshou.

units.zh: 樂羊死，葬於靈壽，其後子孫因家焉。
units.en: Yue Yang died and was buried at Lingshou, and his descendants thereafter made their home there.
units.literal: Yue Yang died, buried at Lingshou, his later descendants thus made home there.

units.zh: 中山復國，至趙武靈王時復滅中山，而樂氏後有樂毅。
units.en: Zhongshan was restored as a state, until Zhao Wu Ling Wang's time when Zhongshan was again extinguished, and the Yue clan later had Yue Yi.
units.literal: Zhongshan restored state, to Zhao Wu Ling Wang time again extinguished Zhongshan, yet Yue clan later had Yue Yi.

units.zh: 樂毅賢，好兵，趙人舉之。
units.en: Yue Yi was worthy and fond of military affairs, the people of Zhao recommended him.
units.literal: Yue Yi worthy, fond of military, Zhao people recommended him.

units.zh: 及武靈王有沙丘之亂，乃去趙適魏。
units.en: When King Wuling of Zhao had the Shaqiu rebellion, Yue Yi left Zhao and went to Wei.
units.literal: When Wu Ling Wang had the Shaqiu rebellion, Yue Yi then left Zhao and went to Wei.

units.zh: 聞燕昭王以子之之亂而齊大敗燕，燕昭王怨齊，未嘗一日而忘報齊也。
units.en: Yue Yi heard that King Zhao of Yan, because of the Zi Zhi rebellion, had been greatly defeated by Qi; King Zhao of Yan resented Qi and never for a single day forgot to avenge Qi.
units.literal: Yue Yi heard that King Zhao of Yan, because of the Zi Zhi rebellion, had been greatly defeated by Qi; King Zhao of Yan resented Qi and never for one day forgot to avenge Qi.

units.zh: 燕國小，辟遠，力不能制，於是屈身下士，先禮郭隗以招賢者。
units.en: Yan was small and remote, its strength could not control matters, thus he humbled himself and treated scholars with respect, first honoring Guo Wei to attract worthy men.
units.literal: Yan state small, remote, strength could not control, thus humbled self treated scholars with respect, first honored Guo Wei to attract worthy men.

units.zh: 樂毅於是為魏昭王使於燕，燕王以客禮待之。
units.en: Yue Yi thus served as envoy from King Zhao of Wei to Yan; the king of Yan treated him with guest courtesy.
units.literal: Yue Yi thus served as Wei Zhao Wang envoy to Yan, Yan king treated him with guest courtesy.

units.zh: 樂毅辭讓，遂委質為臣，燕昭王以為亞卿，久之。
units.en: Yue Yi declined modestly, then submitted his pledge and became a minister; King Zhao of Yan made him vice minister, and he served in that capacity for a long time.
units.literal: Yue Yi declined modestly, then submitted his pledge and became a minister; King Zhao of Yan made him vice minister, and for a long time thereafter.

units.zh: 當是時，齊湣王彊，南敗楚相唐眛於重丘，西摧三晉於觀津，遂與三晉擊秦，助趙滅中山，破宋，廣地千餘里。
units.en: At the time, King Min of Qi was at the height of his power. He defeated the Chu chancellor Tang Mei at Chongqiu in the south, crushed the Three Jin at Guanjin in the west, joined the Three Jin in attacking Qin, helped Zhao destroy Zhongshan, defeated Song, and expanded his territory by more than a thousand li.
units.literal: At this time King Min of Qi was powerful: in the south he defeated the Chu chancellor Tang Mei at Chongqiu; in the west he crushed the Three Jin at Guanjin; then he joined the Three Jin in attacking Qin, aided Zhao in destroying Zhongshan, defeated Song, and expanded his territory by more than one thousand li.

units.zh: 與秦昭王爭重為帝，已而復歸之。
units.en: He even rivaled King Zhao of Qin for imperial precedence, though he later gave up the imperial title.
units.literal: He contended with King Zhao of Qin over precedence as emperor, and afterward returned the title.

units.zh: 諸侯皆欲背秦而服於齊。
units.en: The feudal lords all wished to turn from Qin and submit to Qi.
units.literal: Feudal lords all wished turn from Qin submit to Qi.

units.zh: 湣王自矜，百姓弗堪。
units.en: Min Wang was arrogant, the common people could not bear it.
units.literal: Min Wang arrogant, common people could not bear.

units.zh: 於是燕昭王問伐齊之事。
units.en: King Zhao of Yan therefore asked how Qi might be attacked.
units.literal: Thereupon King Zhao of Yan asked about the matter of attacking Qi.

units.zh: 樂毅對曰：「齊，霸國之餘業也，地大人眾，未易獨攻也。
units.en: Yue Yi replied, "Qi is heir to the power of a hegemon state. Its territory is broad, its population large, and it will not be easy to attack alone.
units.literal: Yue Yi replied, "Qi is the surviving enterprise of a hegemon state; its land is large and its people numerous, and it is not easy to attack alone.

units.zh: 王必欲伐之，莫如與趙及楚、魏。」
units.en: If Your Majesty is determined to attack, the best course is to ally with Zhao, Chu, and Wei."
units.literal: If Your Majesty must attack it, nothing is better than joining with Zhao, Chu, and Wei."

units.zh: 於是使樂毅約趙惠文王，別使連楚、魏，令趙嚪說秦以伐齊之利。
units.en: Thus, he sent Yue Yi to make alliance with King Huiwen of Zhao, separately sent envoys to connect with Chu and Wei, ordered Zhao Yan to persuade Qin of the advantages of attacking Qi.
units.literal: Thus, sent Yue Yi ally with King Huiwen of Zhao, separate envoys connect Chu, Wei, ordered Zhao Yan persuade Qin of attacking Qi advantages.

units.zh: 諸侯害齊湣王之驕暴，皆爭合從與燕伐齊。
units.en: The lords all resented King Min of Qi's arrogant cruelty and hastened to join Yan in an alliance against Qi.
units.literal: The feudal lords resented King Min of Qi's arrogance and violence, and all competed to join the vertical alliance with Yan against Qi.

units.zh: 樂毅還報，燕昭王悉起兵，使樂毅為上將軍，趙惠文王以相國印授樂毅。
units.en: Yue Yi returned and reported. King Zhao of Yan mobilized the whole army and appointed him Supreme General, while King Huiwen of Zhao granted him the chancellor's seal.
units.literal: Yue Yi returned and reported; King Zhao of Yan raised all his troops and made Yue Yi Supreme General, and King Huiwen of Zhao gave Yue Yi the chancellor's seal.

units.zh: 樂毅於是并護趙、楚、韓、魏、燕之兵以伐齊，破之濟西。
units.en: Yue Yi took combined command of the armies of Zhao, Chu, Han, Wei, and Yan, attacked Qi, and defeated it west of the Ji River.
units.literal: Yue Yi then combined and commanded the armies of Zhao, Chu, Han, Wei, and Yan to attack Qi, defeating Qi west of the Ji River.

units.zh: 諸侯兵罷歸，而燕軍樂毅獨追，至于臨菑。
units.en: The feudal lords' troops withdrew and returned, yet Yan's army under Yue Yi alone pursued, reaching Linzi.
units.literal: Feudal lords troops withdrew returned, yet Yan army Yue Yi alone pursued, reaching Linzi.

units.zh: 齊湣王之敗濟西，亡走，保於莒。
units.en: Defeated west of the Ji River, King Min of Qi fled to Ju for refuge.
units.literal: After King Min of Qi was defeated west of the Ji River, he fled and secured himself at Ju.

units.zh: 樂毅獨留徇齊，齊皆城守。
units.en: Yue Yi stayed behind to continue the campaign through Qi, whose forces withdrew behind city walls.
units.literal: Yue Yi alone remained to overrun Qi, while all Qi defended its cities.

units.zh: 樂毅攻入臨菑，盡取齊寶財物祭器輸之燕。
units.en: Yue Yi stormed Linzi, seized Qi's treasures, wealth, and ritual vessels, and carried them off to Yan.
units.literal: Yue Yi attacked and entered Linzi, took all of Qi's treasures, wealth, and sacrificial vessels, and transported them to Yan.

units.zh: 燕昭王大說，親至濟上勞軍，行賞饗士，封樂毅於昌國，號為昌國君。
units.en: King Zhao of Yan was delighted. He went in person to the Ji River to reward the army, distributed honors and feasted the troops, enfeoffed Yue Yi at Changguo, and gave him the title Lord of Changguo.
units.literal: King Zhao of Yan was greatly pleased. He personally went to the Ji River to comfort the army, gave rewards and feasted the soldiers, enfeoffed Yue Yi at Changguo, and titled him Lord of Changguo.

units.zh: 於是燕昭王收齊鹵獲以歸，而使樂毅復以兵平齊城之不下者。
units.en: King Zhao of Yan then returned with the spoils from Qi, leaving Yue Yi with troops to subdue the remaining Qi cities.
units.literal: Thereupon King Zhao of Yan gathered the Qi spoils and returned, while he sent Yue Yi again with troops to pacify the Qi cities that had not submitted.

units.zh: 樂毅留徇齊五歲，下齊七十餘城，皆為郡縣以屬燕，唯獨莒、即墨未服。
units.en: Yue Yi remained campaigning in Qi five years, took seventy plus Qi cities, all made into commanderies and counties belonging to Yan, only Ju and Jimo remained unsubdued.
units.literal: Yue Yi remained campaigning Qi five years, took seventy plus Qi cities, all made commanderies counties belonging Yan, only Ju, Jimo remained unsubdued.

units.zh: 會燕昭王死，子立為燕惠王。
units.en: It happened that King Zhao of Yan died, his son ascended as King Hui of Yan.
units.literal: It happened King Zhao of Yan died, son ascended as King Hui of Yan.

units.zh: 惠王自為太子時嘗不快於樂毅，及即位，齊之田單聞之，乃縱反閒於燕，曰：「齊城不下者兩城耳。
units.en: King Hui of Yan, when he was crown prince, had once been displeased with Yue Yi; when he took the throne, Tian Dan of Qi heard of this and spread counter-rumors in Yan, saying: "Of Qi's cities that have not fallen, there are only two.
units.literal: King Hui of Yan, when crown prince, had once been displeased with Yue Yi; when he took the throne, Tian Dan of Qi heard of this and spread counter-rumors in Yan, saying: "Of Qi's cities that have not fallen, there are only two.

units.zh: 然所以不早拔者，聞樂毅與燕新王有隙，欲連兵且留齊，南面而王齊。
units.en: The only reason those cities have not fallen already is that they hear Yue Yi is estranged from Yan's new king and means to keep the allied armies in Qi, face south, and become king there.
units.literal: The reason they have not been taken sooner is that they have heard Yue Yi has a rift with Yan's new king and wishes to link the armies and remain in Qi, face south, and rule Qi as king.

units.zh: 齊之所患，唯恐他將之來。」
units.en: The only thing Qi fears is the arrival of another general."
units.literal: What Qi fears is only that another general will come."

units.zh: 於是燕惠王固已疑樂毅，得齊反閒，乃使騎劫代將，而召樂毅。
units.en: Thus, King Hui of Yan was already suspicious of Yue Yi, got Qi's reverse rumors, then sent Qi Jie to replace the general, and summoned Yue Yi.
units.literal: Thus, King Hui of Yan was already suspicious Yue Yi, got Qi reverse rumors, then sent Qi Jie replace general, summoned Yue Yi.

units.zh: 樂毅知燕惠王之不善代之，畏誅，遂西降趙。
units.en: Yue Yi understood that King Hui of Yan meant him ill by replacing him. Fearing execution, he went west and submitted to Zhao.
units.literal: Yue Yi knew that King Hui of Yan was not well disposed in replacing him, and fearing execution, went west and surrendered to Zhao.

units.zh: 趙封樂毅於觀津，號曰望諸君。
units.en: Zhao enfeoffed Yue Yi at Guanjin and gave him the title Lord Wangzhu.
units.literal: Zhao enfeoffed Yue Yi at Guanjin and titled him Lord Wangzhu.

units.zh: 尊寵樂毅以警動於燕、齊。
units.en: Zhao treated Yue Yi with honor and favor, using him to alarm both Yan and Qi.
units.literal: Zhao honored and favored Yue Yi in order to alarm and unsettle Yan and Qi.

units.zh: 齊田單後與騎劫戰，果設詐誑燕軍，遂破騎劫於即墨下，而轉戰逐燕，北至河上，盡復得齊城，而迎襄王於莒，入于臨菑。
units.en: Later, Qi's Tian Dan fought Qi Jie and set a trap to deceive the Yan army. He defeated Qi Jie below Jimo, turned the battle around, and drove Yan north to the river. He recovered all Qi cities, welcomed King Xiang at Ju, and entered Linzi.
units.literal: Later Qi Tian Dan battled Qi Jie, indeed set deception tricked Yan army, thus broke Qi Jie below Jimo, turning battle drove Yan, north to river, completely recovered Qi cities, welcomed King Xiang at Ju, entered Linzi.

units.zh: 燕惠王後悔使騎劫代樂毅，以故破軍亡將失齊；
units.en: King Hui of Yan later regretted sending Qi Jie to replace Yue Yi, for the decision had ruined the army, cost him his generals, and lost Yan its gains in Qi;
units.literal: King Hui of Yan later regretted sending Qi Jie to replace Yue Yi, because it had broken the army, lost the generals, and lost Qi;

units.zh: 又怨樂毅之降趙，恐趙用樂毅而乘燕之獘以伐燕。
units.en: Again resented Yue Yi's surrender to Zhao, feared Zhao would use Yue Yi and take advantage of Yan's defeat to attack Yan.
units.literal: Again resented Yue Yi surrender Zhao, feared Zhao use Yue Yi take advantage Yan defeat attack Yan.

units.zh: 燕惠王乃使人讓樂毅，且謝之曰：「先王舉國而委將軍，將軍為燕破齊，報先王之讎，天下莫不震動，寡人豈敢一日而忘將軍之功哉！
units.en: King Hui of Yan then sent someone both to reproach Yue Yi and to apologize: "The former king entrusted the whole state to you. You defeated Qi for Yan and avenged his wrongs, until all under Heaven was shaken. How could I dare forget your merit for even one day!
units.literal: King Hui of Yan then sent a man to reproach Yue Yi, while also apologizing, saying, "The former king entrusted the entire state to the general. For Yan, the general broke Qi and avenged the former king's enmity, shaking all under Heaven. How would I dare forget the general's merit for even a single day!

units.zh: 會先王棄群臣，寡人新即位，左右誤寡人。
units.en: But the former king had just passed from us, I had only newly taken the throne, and my attendants misled me.
units.literal: It happened that the former king abandoned his ministers, I had newly ascended the throne, and those around me misled me.

units.zh: 寡人之使騎劫代將軍，為將軍久暴露於外，故召將軍且休，計事。
units.en: I sent Qi Jie to replace you only because you had long been exposed in the field; I meant to recall you for rest and consultation.
units.literal: My sending Qi Jie to replace the general was because the general had long been exposed outside; I therefore summoned the general to rest and to plan affairs.

units.zh: 將軍過聽，以與寡人有隙，遂捐燕歸趙。
units.en: You heard wrongly, believed there was a rift between us, and abandoned Yan for Zhao.
units.literal: The general listened wrongly, thinking there was a rift with me, and so abandoned Yan and went to Zhao.

units.zh: 將軍自為計則可矣，而亦何以報先王之所以遇將軍之意乎？」
units.en: You may look to your own safety, but how does this repay the former king's treatment of you?"
units.literal: The general may make plans for himself, but how will he repay the meaning with which the former king treated the general?"

units.zh: 樂毅報遺燕惠王書曰：
units.en: Yue Yi replied by sending King Hui of Yan a letter saying:
units.literal: Yue Yi replied sent King Hui of Yan letter saying:

units.zh: 臣不佞，不能奉承王命，以順左右之心，恐傷先王之明，有害足下之義，故遁逃走趙。
units.en: Your minister is not talented, could not accept Your Majesty's command, to comply with the hearts of those around you, feared harming the former king's wisdom, harming Your Majesty's righteousness, thus fled and went to Zhao.
units.literal: Minister not talented, could not accept wang command, to comply attendants hearts, feared harming former king wisdom, harming majesty righteousness, thus fled went Zhao.

units.zh: 今足下使人數之以罪，臣恐侍御者不察先王之所以畜幸臣之理，又不白臣之所以事先王之心，故敢以書對。
units.en: Now Your Majesty sends people to enumerate my crimes, your minister fears the attendants do not examine the former king's reasons for nurturing and favoring your minister, and do not understand your minister's heart in serving the former king, thus dares to respond with a letter.
units.literal: Now majesty sends people enumerate crimes, minister fears attendants not examine former king reasons nurturing favoring minister, not understand minister heart serving former king, thus dares respond with letter.

units.zh: 臣聞賢聖之君不以祿私親，其功多者賞之，其能當者處之。
units.en: Your minister has heard that worthy sage lords do not favor relatives with salary, those with much merit they reward, those whose ability matches they place.
units.literal: Minister heard worthy sage lords not favor relatives with salary, those merit many reward them, those ability match place them.

units.zh: 故察能而授官者，成功之君也；
units.en: Thus, those who examine ability and grant office are successful lords;
units.literal: Thus, examine ability grant office, successful lords;

units.zh: 論行而結交者，立名之士也。
units.en: Those who discuss conduct and form friendships are scholars who establish names.
units.literal: Discuss conduct form friendships, establish name scholars.

units.zh: 臣竊觀先王之舉也，見有高世主之心，故假節於魏，以身得察於燕。
units.en: I privately observed the former king's conduct and saw in him the mind of a ruler who surpassed his age. For that reason I borrowed credentials from Wei and presented myself for service in Yan.
units.literal: Your minister privately observed the former king's actions and saw that he had the mind of a ruler above his age; therefore I borrowed a credential from Wei so that my person might be examined by Yan.

units.zh: 先王過舉，廁之賓客之中，立之群臣之上，不謀父兄，以為亞卿。
units.en: The former king over-elevated, placed him among the guests, established him above the ministers, did not consult father and brothers, made him vice minister.
units.literal: Former king over-elevated, placed among guests, established above ministers, not consulted father brothers, made vice minister.

units.zh: 臣竊不自知，自以為奉令承教，可幸無罪，故受令而不辭。
units.en: Your minister secretly did not know himself, thought receiving orders and accepting teachings, might fortunately be without crime, thus accepted orders without declining.
units.literal: Minister secretly not know self, thought receiving orders accepting teachings, might fortunately without crime, thus accepted orders without declining.

units.zh: 先王命之曰：「我有積怨深怒於齊，不量輕弱，而欲以齊為事。」
units.en: The former king told me, "I bear old resentment and deep anger toward Qi. Though my strength is slight, I wish to make Qi my great undertaking."
units.literal: The former king commanded me, saying, "I have accumulated resentment and deep anger toward Qi; not measuring my light and weak position, I wish to make Qi my undertaking."

units.zh: 臣曰：「夫齊，霸國之餘業而最勝之遺事也。
units.en: I replied, "Qi is heir to a hegemon's power and to the legacy of great victories.
units.literal: Your minister said, "Qi is the surviving enterprise of a hegemon state and the remnant of its greatest victories.

units.zh: 練於兵甲，習於戰攻。
units.en: Trained in armor and weapons, practiced in battle and attack.
units.literal: Trained armor weapons, practiced battle attack.

units.zh: 王若欲伐之，必與天下圖之。
units.en: If Your Majesty wishes to attack it, must plan with the world.
units.literal: Wang if wish attack it, must with world plan it.

units.zh: 與天下圖之，莫若結於趙。
units.en: If we are to plan this with the wider world, nothing is better than securing Zhao.
units.literal: To plan this with all under Heaven, nothing is better than forming ties with Zhao.

units.zh: 且又淮北、宋地，楚魏之所欲也，趙若許而約四國攻之，齊可大破也。」
units.en: Moreover, Chu and Wei covet the lands north of the Huai and the lands of Song. If Zhao agrees, and we form a four-state pact to attack Qi, it can be crushed."
units.literal: Moreover, the lands north of the Huai and the territory of Song are what Chu and Wei desire; if Zhao agrees and we covenant with the four states to attack it, Qi can be greatly broken."

units.zh: 先王以為然，具符節南使臣於趙。
units.en: The former king considered it right, prepared credentials and south sent your minister to Zhao.
units.literal: Former king considered right, prepared credentials south sent minister Zhao.

units.zh: 顧反命，起兵擊齊。
units.en: Turned back and reported, raised troops to attack Qi.
units.literal: Turned back reported, raised troops attacked Qi.

units.zh: 以天之道，先王之靈，河北之地隨先王而舉之濟上。
units.en: By Heaven's Way and the former king's spirit, the lands north of the River rallied to him, and the campaign rose on the banks of the Ji.
units.literal: By Heaven's Way and the spirit of the former king, the lands north of the River followed the former king and were raised on the Ji River.

units.zh: 濟上之軍受命擊齊，大敗齊人。
units.en: The army on the Ji River received its orders, attacked Qi, and inflicted a great defeat.
units.literal: The army on the Ji River received orders to attack Qi and greatly defeated the Qi men.

units.zh: 輕卒銳兵，長驅至國。
units.en: Light troops sharp weapons, long drove to the capital.
units.literal: Light troops sharp weapons, long drove to capital.

units.zh: 齊王遁而走莒，僅以身免；
units.en: The Qi king fled and went to Ju, barely escaped with his life;
units.literal: Qi king fled went Ju, barely escaped with body;

units.zh: 珠玉財寶車甲珍器盡收入于燕。
units.en: Pearls, jade, treasures, chariots, armor, and precious vessels all flowed into Yan.
units.literal: Pearls, jade, wealth, treasure, chariots, armor, and precious vessels were all taken into Yan.

units.zh: 齊器設於寧臺，大呂陳於元英，故鼎反乎磿室，薊丘之植植於汶篁，自五伯已來，功未有及先王者也。
units.en: Qi vessels set up at Ning Terrace, Da Lu displayed at Yuan Ying, ancient tripods returned to Ao chamber, Jiqiu's plants planted at Wen Huang, since the five hegemons, merit has not equaled the former king.
units.literal: Qi vessels set Ning Terrace, Da Lu displayed Yuan Ying, ancient tripods returned Ao chamber, Jiqiu plants planted Wen Huang, since five hegemons, merit not equaled former king.

units.zh: 先王以為慊於志，故裂地而封之，使得比小國諸侯。
units.en: The former king considered it satisfying to his ambitions, thus split land and enfeoffed him, allowing him to compare to small state feudal lords.
units.literal: Former king considered satisfying ambitions, thus split land enfeoffed him, allowed compare small state feudal lords.

units.zh: 臣竊不自知，自以為奉命承教，可幸無罪，是以受命不辭。
units.en: Your minister secretly did not know himself, thought receiving orders accepting teachings, might fortunately be without crime, thus accepted orders without declining.
units.literal: Minister secretly not know self, thought receiving orders accepting teachings, might fortunately without crime, thus accepted orders without declining.

units.zh: 臣聞賢聖之君，功立而不廢，故著於春秋；
units.en: Your minister has heard that worthy sage lords establish merit and do not abandon it, thus are recorded in the Spring and Autumn;
units.literal: Minister heard worthy sage lords, merit established not abandoned, thus recorded Spring Autumn;

units.zh: 蚤知之士，名成而不毀，故稱於後世。
units.en: Early knowing scholars establish names and do not destroy them, thus are praised in later generations.
units.literal: Early knowing scholars, name established not destroyed, thus praised later generations.

units.zh: 若先王之報怨雪恥，夷萬乘之彊國，收八百歲之蓄積，及至棄群臣之日，餘教未衰，執政任事之臣，修法令，慎庶孽，施及乎萌隸，皆可以教後世。
units.en: As for the former king, he avenged his resentment and washed away shame, leveled a mighty state of ten thousand chariots, and seized the accumulated stores of eight hundred years. Even on the day he left his ministers behind, his remaining teachings had not declined: the ministers in charge of government handled affairs, maintained laws and commands, carefully managed the many collateral descendants, and extended order down to the common servants. All this can instruct later generations.
units.literal: As for former king avenging resentment washing shame, leveling ten thousand chariot strong states, collecting eight hundred years accumulation, to day abandoned ministers, remaining teachings not declined, governing administering affairs ministers, repairing law commands, careful numerous descendants, extending sprouting servants, all can teach later generations.

units.zh: 臣聞之，善作者不必善成，善始者不必善終。
units.en: I have heard that those who are good at opening an enterprise are not always good at completing it, and those who begin well do not always end well.
units.literal: Your minister has heard that one skilled at initiating is not necessarily skilled at completing, and one skilled at beginning is not necessarily skilled at ending.

units.zh: 昔伍子胥說聽於闔閭，而吳王遠跡至郢；
units.en: Formerly Wu Zixu's counsel was heeded by Helü, and the king of Wu pushed as far as Ying;
units.literal: Formerly wuzi Xu persuasion listened He Lu, Wu king far went Ying;

units.zh: 夫差弗是也，賜之鴟夷而浮之江。
units.en: King Fuchai of Wu did otherwise: he had Zixu put in a leather sack and cast into the river.
units.literal: King Fuchai of Wu did otherwise: he had Zixu put in a leather sack and cast into the river.

units.zh: 吳王不寤先論之可以立功，故沈子胥而不悔；
units.en: The king of Wu failed to understand that Zixu's earlier counsel could have secured his achievement, and so had Zixu cast into the river without regret;
units.literal: The king of Wu failed to understand that Zixu's earlier counsel could have secured his achievement, and so had Zixu cast into the river without regret;

units.zh: 子胥不蚤見主之不同量，是以至於入江而不化。
units.en: Zixu failed to recognize early enough that his ruler was made of different stuff, and so ended up in the river, his body uncorrupted.
units.literal: Zixu failed to recognize early enough that his ruler was made of different stuff, and so ended up in the river, his body uncorrupted.

units.zh: 夫免身立功，以明先王之跡，臣之上計也。
units.en: Escaping the body and establishing merit, to clarify the former king's traces, is your minister's highest plan.
units.literal: Escaping body establishing merit, to clarify former king traces, minister highest plan.

units.zh: 離毀辱之誹謗，墮先王之名，臣之所大恐也。
units.en: Separating from slander and humiliation, destroying the former king's name, is what your minister greatly fears.
units.literal: Separating slander humiliation defamation, destroying former king name, minister greatly fears.

units.zh: 臨不測之罪，以幸為利，義之所不敢出也。
units.en: To face arbitrary punishment and count mere survival as a gain is something righteousness will not permit me to do.
units.literal: To face an unpredictable crime and take survival as profit is something righteousness does not dare produce.

units.zh: 臣聞古之君子，交絕不出惡聲；
units.en: Your minister has heard that ancient gentlemen, when friendships end, do not issue evil sounds;
units.literal: Minister heard ancient gentlemen, friendships end not issue evil sounds;

units.zh: 忠臣去國，不絜其名。
units.en: Loyal ministers leaving their states do not purify their names.
units.literal: Loyal ministers leaving states, not purify their names.

units.zh: 臣雖不佞，數奉教於君子矣。
units.en: Your minister though not talented, has several times received teachings from gentlemen.
units.literal: Minister though not talented, several times received teachings gentlemen.

units.zh: 恐侍御者之親左右之說，不察疏遠之行，故敢獻書以聞，唯君王之留意焉。
units.en: Fearing the attendants' favoring the words of those close by, not examining distant conduct, thus dares to offer this letter to report, only Your Majesty's attention.
units.literal: Fearing attendants favoring close by words, not examining distant conduct, thus dares offer letter report, only Your Majesty attention.

units.zh: 於是燕王復以樂毅子樂閒為昌國君；
units.en: Thus, the Yan king again made Yue Yi's son Yue Xian the Changguo Jun;
units.literal: Thus, Yan king again made Yue Yi son Yue Xian Changguo Jun;

units.zh: 而樂毅往來復通燕，燕、趙以為客卿。
units.en: And Yue Yi came and went again communicating with Yan, Yan and Zhao made him guest minister.
units.literal: Yue Yi came went again communicated Yan, Yan Zhao made guest minister.

units.zh: 樂毅卒於趙。
units.en: Yue Yi died in Zhao.
units.literal: Yue Yi died in Zhao.

units.zh: 樂閒居燕三十餘年，燕王喜用其相栗腹之計，欲攻趙，而問昌國君樂閒。
units.en: Yue Xian dwelt in Yan for more than thirty years; King Xi of Yan employed his chancellor Li Fu's plan, wished to attack Zhao, and questioned Lord of Changguo Yue Xian.
units.literal: Yue Xian dwelt in Yan thirty-plus years; King Xi of Yan employed his chancellor Li Fu's plan, wished to attack Zhao, and questioned Lord of Changguo Yue Xian.

units.zh: 樂閒曰：「趙，四戰之國也，其民習兵，伐之不可。」
units.en: Yue Xian said, "Zhao is a state exposed to war on all four sides, and its people are used to fighting. An attack will not succeed."
units.literal: Yue Xian said, "Zhao is a state of warfare on four sides; its people are practiced in arms. It cannot be attacked."

units.zh: 燕王不聽，遂伐趙。
units.en: The Yan king did not listen, thus attacked Zhao.
units.literal: Yan king not listen, thus attacked Zhao.

units.zh: 趙使廉頗擊之，大破栗腹之軍於鄗，禽栗腹、樂乘。
units.en: Zhao sent Lian Po to attack them, greatly broke Li Fu's army at Hao, captured Li Fu and Yue Cheng.
units.literal: Zhao sent Lian Po attacked them, greatly broke Li Fu army at Hao, captured Li Fu, Yue Cheng.

units.zh: 樂乘者，樂閒之宗也。
units.en: Yue Cheng was Yue Xian's clan relative.
units.literal: Yue Cheng was Yue Xian clan relative.

units.zh: 於是樂閒奔趙，趙遂圍燕。
units.en: Thus, Yue Xian fled to Zhao, Zhao then surrounded Yan.
units.literal: Thus, Yue Xian fled Zhao, Zhao then surrounded Yan.

units.zh: 燕重割地以與趙和，趙乃解而去。
units.en: Yan heavily cut land to make peace with Zhao, Zhao then withdrew and left.
units.literal: Yan heavily cut land to make peace Zhao, Zhao then withdrew left.

units.zh: 燕王恨不用樂閒，樂閒既在趙，乃遺樂閒書曰：「紂之時，箕子不用，犯諫不怠，以冀其聽；
units.en: The king of Yan regretted not having listened to Yue Xian. Since Yue Xian was now in Zhao, he sent him a letter: "In the time of Zhou, Jizi was not used, yet he kept remonstrating at personal risk, hoping Zhou would listen;
units.literal: The king of Yan regretted not using Yue Xian. Since Yue Xian was already in Zhao, he sent Yue Xian a letter saying, "In the time of Zhou, Jizi was not employed; he committed remonstrance without slackening, hoping Zhou would listen;

units.zh: 商容不達，身祇辱焉，以冀其變。
units.en: Shang Rong was ignored, yet he endured humiliation in hope that Zhou would change.
units.literal: Shang Rong was not understood; he personally bore humiliation, hoping for change.

units.zh: 及民志不入，獄囚自出，然後二子退隱。
units.en: Only when the people would no longer submit and prisoners were walking out of the jails on their own did the two men withdraw into seclusion.
units.literal: When the people's will no longer entered and prisoners left the jails by themselves, only then did the two men withdraw and hide.

units.zh: 故紂負桀暴之累，二子不失忠聖之名。
units.en: Thus, Zhou carried the infamy of Jie's tyranny, while those two men kept their reputations as loyal sages.
units.literal: Thus Zhou bore the accumulated burden of Jie's violence, while the two men did not lose their names as loyal sages.

units.zh: 何者？
units.en: Why?
units.literal: Why?

units.zh: 其憂患之盡矣。
units.en: Their worries and sufferings were exhausted.
units.literal: Their worries sufferings exhausted.

units.zh: 今寡人雖愚，不若紂之暴也；
units.en: Now though I am foolish, not like Zhou's tyranny;
units.literal: Now though I foolish, not like Zhou tyranny;

units.zh: 燕民雖亂，不若殷民之甚也。
units.en: Yan people though chaotic, not like Yin people's extremity.
units.literal: Yan people though chaotic, not like Yin people extremity.

units.zh: 室有語，不相盡，以告鄰里。
units.en: Words spoken within the household, before they have been fully shared among kin, should not be carried off and told to the neighbors.
units.literal: If there are words inside the house, and they have not been fully shared with one another, one does not take them to tell the neighbors.

units.zh: 二者，寡人不為君取也。」
units.en: These two courses are not ones I would choose for you."
units.literal: As for these two, I would not choose them for you, sir."

units.zh: 樂閒、樂乘怨燕不聽其計，二人卒留趙。
units.en: Yue Xian and Yue Cheng resented Yan not listening to their plans, the two finally stayed in Zhao.
units.literal: Yue Xian, Yue Cheng resented Yan not listening plans, two finally stayed Zhao.

units.zh: 趙封樂乘為武襄君。
units.en: Zhao enfeoffed Yue Cheng as Lord Wuxiang.
units.literal: Zhao enfeoffed Yue Cheng as Lord Wuxiang.

units.zh: 其明年，樂乘、廉頗為趙圍燕，燕重禮以和，乃解。
units.en: The next year, Yue Cheng and Lian Po for Zhao surrounded Yan, Yan heavily bestowed gifts to make peace, then withdrew.
units.literal: Next year, Yue Cheng, Lian Po for Zhao surrounded Yan, Yan heavily bestowed gifts to make peace, then withdrew.

units.zh: 後五歲，趙孝成王卒。
units.en: Five years afterward, King Xiaocheng of Zhao died.
units.literal: After five years, King Xiaocheng of Zhao died.

units.zh: 襄王使樂乘代廉頗。
units.en: King Xiang appointed Yue Cheng to take Lian Po's place.
units.literal: King Xiang sent Yue Cheng to replace Lian Po.

units.zh: 廉頗攻樂乘，樂乘走，廉頗亡入魏。
units.en: Lian Po attacked Yue Cheng, Yue Cheng fled, Lian Po fled and entered Wei.
units.literal: Lian Po attacked Yue Cheng, Yue Cheng fled, Lian Po fled entered Wei.

units.zh: 其後十六年而秦滅趙。
units.en: Thereafter, sixteen years passed, and Qin extinguished Zhao.
units.literal: Thereafter sixteen years Qin extinguished Zhao.

units.zh: 其後二十餘年，高帝過趙，問：「樂毅有後世乎？」
units.en: Thereafter, more than twenty years later, Gao Di passed through Zhao and asked: 'Does Yue Yi have descendants?'
units.literal: Thereafter twenty plus years, Gao Di passed Zhao, asked: 'Yue Yi has descendants?'

units.zh: 對曰：「有樂叔。」
units.en: Replied: 'There is Yue Shu.'
units.literal: Replied: 'Has Yue Shu.'

units.zh: 高帝封之樂卿，號曰華成君。
units.en: Gao Di enfeoffed him at Yueqing and titled him Lord Huacheng.
units.literal: Gao Di enfeoffed him at Yueqing and titled him Lord Huacheng.

units.zh: 華成君，樂毅之孫也。
units.en: Lord Huacheng was Yue Yi's grandson.
units.literal: Lord Huacheng was Yue Yi's grandson.

units.zh: 而樂氏之族有樂瑕公、樂臣公，趙且為秦所滅，亡之齊高密。
units.en: And the Yue clan had Yue Xiagong, Yue Chengong, Zhao was about to be extinguished by Qin, fled to Qi Gaomi.
units.literal: Yue clan had Yue Xiagong, Yue Chengong, Zhao about to be extinguished by Qin, fled Qi Gaomi.

units.zh: 樂臣公善修黃帝、老子之言，顯聞於齊，稱賢師。
units.en: Yue Chengong was expert in the teachings of Huangdi and Laozi. He became well known in Qi and was regarded as a worthy teacher.
units.literal: Yue Chengong was skilled at cultivating the teachings of Huangdi and Laozi, became prominent and known in Qi, and was called a worthy teacher.

units.zh: 太史公曰：始齊之蒯通及主父偃讀樂毅之報燕王書，未嘗不廢書而泣也。
units.en: The Grand Historian said: Whenever Kuai Tong of Qi and Zhufu Yan first read Yue Yi's reply to the king of Yan, they would lay the text aside and weep.
units.literal: The Grand Historian said: At first, whenever Kuai Tong of Qi and Zhufu Yan read Yue Yi's letter replying to the king of Yan, they never failed to put down the book and weep.

units.zh: 樂臣公學黃帝、老子，其本師號曰河上丈人，不知其所出。
units.en: Yue Chengong studied Huangdi and Laozi. His original teacher was known as the Elder on the River, though his origins are unknown.
units.literal: Yue Chengong studied Huangdi and Laozi; his root teacher was called the Elder on the River, but where he came from is unknown.

units.zh: 河上丈人教安期生，安期生教毛翕公，毛翕公教樂瑕公，樂瑕公教樂臣公，樂臣公教蓋公。
units.en: The Elder on the River taught An Qisheng; An Qisheng taught Mao Xigong; Mao Xigong taught Yue Xiagong; Yue Xiagong taught Yue Chengong; and Yue Chengong taught Gai Gong.
units.literal: The Elder on the River taught An Qisheng; An Qisheng taught Mao Xigong; Mao Xigong taught Yue Xiagong; Yue Xiagong taught Yue Chengong; Yue Chengong taught Gai Gong.

units.zh: 蓋公教於齊高密、膠西，為曹相國師。
units.en: Gai Gong taught in Qi Gaomi and Jiaoxi, was Cao Xiangguo's teacher.
units.literal: Gai Gong taught in Qi Gaomi, Jiaoxi, was Cao Xiangguo teacher.

units.zh: 然億兆夷人，卒降十亂，紂之百克，終自無後，潁川之戰，即是殷監。
units.en: Yet when the hundred millions of the Yi people submitted, Zhou's ten capable ministers prevailed; King Zhou's hundred victories in the end left him without heirs—the battle at Yingchuan is the warning of Yin.
units.literal: Yet when the hundred millions of the Yi people submitted, the ten rebels of Zhou fell; Zhou's hundred victories in the end left him without heirs — the battle at Yingchuan is the warning of Yin.

units.zh: 又求「樂毅有後乎？」
units.en: He also asked: "Does Yue Yi have descendants?"
units.literal: He also asked: "Does Yue Yi have descendants?"

units.zh: 然而兵殆於垂涉，唐昧死焉；
units.en: However, their troops were endangered at Chui and She, and Tang Mei died there.
units.literal: However, troops endangered at Chui She, Tang Mei died there;

units.zh: 楚人鮫革犀兕，所以為甲，堅如金石；
units.en: The people of Chu used shark hide, rhinoceros hide, and buffalo hide to make armor as hard as metal and stone.
units.literal: Chu people shark hide rhinoceros buffalo, thus make armor, hard like metal stone;

units.zh: 漢則馬遷、蕭望，晉則裴楷、張華。
units.en: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.
units.literal: In Han there were Sima Qian and Xiao Wangzhi; in Jin there were Pei Kai and Zhang Hua.

units.zh: 又嘗令左右誦漢書，臥而聽之，至蒯通說韓信曰「相君之背，貴不可言」，寶應蹶然起曰「可謂智士」。
units.en: He once had his attendants read the Book of Han aloud while he listened from his couch. When they reached Kuai Tong's advice to Han Xin—"If you turn your back on Han, your rank will be beyond words"—Baoying sprang up and exclaimed, "A truly wise man!"
units.literal: He once had his attendants recite the Book of Han while he listened lying down. When they came to Kuai Tong telling Han Xin, "When I read your back, your nobility is beyond words," Baoying sprang up and said, "He can truly be called a wise man."

units.zh: 沈炯 虞荔 弟寄 馬樞
units.en: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu
units.literal: Shen Jiong; Yu Li; younger brother Ji; Ma Shu

units.zh: 高祖，沛豐邑中陽里人也，姓劉氏。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu was born in Zhongyang Village in the town of Fengyi, Pei County. His surname was Liu.
units.literal: The Supreme Ancestor was a person of Zhongyang Village, Fengyi Town, Pei County, and his surname was Liu.

units.zh: 蕭何曰：「劉季固多大言，少成事。」
units.en: Xiao He said: "Liu Ji certainly talks big but accomplishes little."
units.literal: Xiao He said: "Liu Ji indeed makes many big claims, accomplishes few matters."

units.zh: 秦二年十月，沛公攻胡陵、方與，還守豐。
units.en: In the tenth month of the second year of Qin, Pei Gong attacked Hu Ling and Fang Yu, then returned to defend Feng.
units.literal: Qin second year tenth month, Pei Gong attacked Hu Ling and Fang Yu, returned to defend Feng.

units.zh: 呂公曰：「臣少好相人，相人多矣，無如季相，願季自愛。
units.en: Lü Gong said: "Since I was young, I've enjoyed reading faces. I've read many people's faces, but none compare to Ji's. I hope Ji takes good care of himself.
units.literal: Lü Gong said: "I from youth favored physiognomy, have read many people's faces, none like Ji's appearance, wish Ji to take care of himself.

units.zh: 臣有息女，願為箕帚妾。」
units.en: I have a young daughter and wish to make her Ji's humble servant."
units.literal: I have a young daughter, wish to make her Ji's broom and dustpan servant."

units.zh: 沛令善公，求之不與，何自妄許與劉季？」
units.en: The magistrate of Pei was your friend and asked for her, but you wouldn't give her. Why are you now rashly promising her to Liu Ji?"
units.literal: The Pei magistrate was friendly with you, requested her and you did not give, why now rashly promise her to Liu Ji?"

units.zh: 呂后曰：「季所居上常有雲氣，故從往常得季。」
units.en: Empress Lü said: "There are always clouds above where you stay. That's why we can always find you by following them."
units.literal: Empress Lu said: 'Where Ji resides above constantly has cloud aura, therefore following it constantly finds Ji.'

units.zh: 諸父老皆曰：「平生所聞劉季奇怪，當貴，且卜筮之，莫如劉季最吉。」
units.en: All the elders said: "In our lifetimes we have heard that Liu Ji is strange and marked for nobility. Moreover, when we divined on it, none was more auspicious than Liu Ji."
units.literal: All the elders said: 'In our lives we have heard Liu Ji is strange and extraordinary, should be noble, moreover divining it, none is more auspicious than Liu Ji.'

units.zh: 已而有娠，遂產高祖。
units.en: Soon after, she became pregnant and gave birth to Emperor Gaozu.
units.literal: Soon after she became pregnant, and then gave birth to the Supreme Ancestor.

units.zh: 高祖為人，隆準而龍顏，美須髯，左股有七十二黑子。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu had a prominent nose, a face like a dragon, beautiful whiskers and beard, and seventy-two black moles on his left thigh.
units.literal: The Supreme Ancestor as a person had a high nose and dragon face, beautiful beard and whiskers, and on his left thigh there were seventy-two black moles.

units.zh: 高祖每酤留飲，酒讎數倍。
units.en: Whenever Emperor Gaozu bought wine, he stayed to drink, and the bill was several times higher.
units.literal: The Supreme Ancestor each time he bought wine would stay and drink, the wine price several times.

units.zh: 高祖常繇咸陽，縱觀秦皇帝，喟然大息，曰：「嗟乎，大丈夫當如此矣！」
units.en: Emperor Gaozu often passed through Xianyang and gazed upon the Qin emperor. He would sigh deeply and say: "Ah, this is how a true man should live!"
units.literal: The Supreme Ancestor often performed corvée service at Xianyang and was allowed to observe the Qin emperor; he sighed deeply and said: "Alas, a great man should be like this!"

units.zh: 高祖為亭長，素易諸吏，乃紿為謁曰「賀錢萬」，實不持一錢。
units.en: As pavilion chief, Emperor Gaozu had always treated the officials lightly. He deceived them by having the announcement read "Congratulatory gift: ten thousand cash," though in fact he did not bring a single coin.
units.literal: The Supreme Ancestor was pavilion chief, usually casual with the officials, then deceived to make the announcement saying "Congratulatory money ten thousand," in reality he did not bring a single cash.

units.zh: 呂公者，好相人，見高祖狀貌，因重敬之，引入坐上坐。
units.en: Lü Gong was skilled in reading faces. When he saw Emperor Gaozu's appearance, he was greatly impressed and led him inside to be seated in the place of honor.
units.literal: Lü Gong was good at physiognomy, saw the Supreme Ancestor's appearance, because of this greatly respected him, led him in to sit in the seat of honor.

units.zh: 高祖因狎侮諸客，遂坐上坐，無所詘。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu took advantage of this to treat all the guests with casual familiarity and even insult them. He sat in the place of honor without showing any humility.
units.literal: The Supreme Ancestor because of this treated the various guests with familiarity and insult, then sat in the seat of honor, was not humble in any way.

units.zh: 酒闌，呂公因目固留高祖。
units.en: As the banquet ended, Lü Gong signaled insistently to keep Emperor Gaozu there.
units.literal: The wine came to an end, Lü Gong because of this gave meaningful looks and firmly kept the Supreme Ancestor.

units.zh: 卒與高祖。
units.en: In the end, she married Emperor Gaozu.
units.literal: In the end he married with the Supreme Ancestor.

units.zh: 高祖嘗告歸之田。
units.en: Once, Emperor Gaozu requested leave to return to his fields.
units.literal: The Supreme Ancestor once requested leave to return to the fields.

units.zh: 老父已去，高祖適從旁舍來，呂后具言客有過，相我子母皆大貴。
units.en: The old man had already left. Emperor Gaozu had just returned from a neighboring house. Empress Lü told him everything: a guest had passed by and read the faces of her, the children, and her mother—they were all greatly noble.
units.literal: The old man had already left; Gaozu had just come from the neighboring house. Empress Lü told him in full that a guest had passed by and read the faces of her and her children—all were greatly noble.

units.zh: 高祖問，曰：「未遠。」
units.en: Emperor Gaozu asked where the old man had gone. She said, "Not far."
units.literal: Gaozu asked, said: 'Not far.'

units.zh: 高祖乃謝曰：「誠如父言，不敢忘德。」
units.en: Emperor Gaozu then thanked him and said: "If what you say is true, I won't forget your kindness."
units.literal: Gaozu then thanked saying: 'Truly as father says, do not dare forget the kindness.'

units.zh: 及高祖貴，遂不知老父處。
units.en: When Emperor Gaozu rose to power, he could no longer find the old man.
units.literal: When Gaozu became noble, then did not know the old father's whereabouts.

units.zh: 高祖為亭長，乃鲈竹皮為冠，令求盜之薛治，時時冠之，及貴常冠，所謂「劉氏冠」也。
units.en: While he was pavilion chief, Emperor Gaozu made a cap of bamboo sheathing. When he was sent to pursue bandits in the Xue district he wore it from time to time, and after he rose high he still wore it constantly. This is what was called the "Liu family cap."
units.literal: While Gaozu was pavilion chief, he made a cap of bamboo sheathing; he was ordered to pursue bandits in the Xue district and wore it from time to time; after he rose high he still wore it constantly—this is what is called the "Liu family cap."

units.zh: 高祖以亭長為縣送徒驪山，徒多道亡。
units.en: As pavilion chief, Emperor Gaozu was assigned by the county to escort convicts to Mount Li. Many of the convicts fled along the road.
units.literal: Gaozu as pavilion chief was ordered by the county to escort convicts to Mount Li, the convicts many fled on the road.

units.zh: 高祖被酒，夜徑澤中，令一人行前。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu was drunk and at night went directly through the marsh, ordering one man to go ahead.
units.literal: Gaozu was drunk, at night went straight through the marshes, ordered one person to go ahead.

units.zh: 高祖醉，曰：「壯士行，何畏！」
units.en: Emperor Gaozu was drunk and said: "A brave man walks on. What is there to fear!"
units.literal: Gaozu was drunk, said: 'A brave man walks forward, what is there to fear!'

units.zh: 後人至，高祖覺。
units.en: Later people arrived, and Emperor Gaozu woke up.
units.literal: Later people arrived, Gaozu awoke.

units.zh: 告高祖，高祖乃心獨喜，自負。
units.en: They told Emperor Gaozu, who was secretly delighted and grew confident in himself.
units.literal: Told Gaozu, Gaozu then in his heart alone rejoiced, considered himself superior.

units.zh: 高祖隱於芒、碭山澤間，呂后與人俱求，常得之。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu hid in the mountains and marshes between Mang and Dang. Empress Lü and others searched for him together and always found him.
units.literal: Gaozu hid in the mountains and marshes between Mang and Dang, Empress Lu and others together sought him, constantly found him.

units.zh: 高祖怪問之。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu was surprised and asked how.
units.literal: Gaozu strangely questioned her.

units.zh: 高祖又喜。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu was delighted once more.
units.literal: Gaozu again was happy.

units.zh: 乃令樊噲召高祖。
units.en: He then ordered Fan Kuai to summon Gaozu.
units.literal: He then ordered Fan Kuai to summon Gaozu.

units.zh: 高祖之眾已數百人矣。
units.en: Gaozu's following already numbered several hundred men.
units.literal: Gaozu's following already numbered several hundred men.

units.zh: 於是樊噲從高祖來。
units.en: So Fan Kuai came to follow Emperor Gaozu.
units.literal: Therefore Fan Kuai followed Gaozu and came.

units.zh: 蕭、曹恐，踰城保高祖。
units.en: Xiao and Cao were afraid, so they climbed over the wall to join Emperor Gaozu.
units.literal: Xiao and Cao feared, climbed over the wall to protect Gaozu.

units.zh: 高祖乃書帛射城上，與沛父老曰：「天下同苦秦久矣。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu then wrote on silk and shot it onto the city wall, saying to the elders of Pei: "All under heaven have suffered under Qin for a long time.
units.literal: Gaozu then wrote on silk and shot it onto the city wall, telling the Pei elders: 'The world together has suffered under Qin for a long time.

units.zh: 父老乃帥子弟共殺沛令，開城門迎高祖，欲以為沛令。
units.en: The elders then led the young men together to kill the magistrate of Pei, opened the city gates to welcome Emperor Gaozu, and wanted to make him magistrate of Pei.
units.literal: The elders then led the young men together to kill the Pei magistrate, opened the city gates to welcome Gaozu, wished to make him Pei magistrate.

units.zh: 高祖曰：「天下方擾，諸侯並起，令置將不善，一敗塗地。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu said: "The world is in chaos right now, with feudal lords rising up everywhere. If you appoint a commander who is not capable, one defeat will ruin everything.
units.literal: Gaozu said: 'The world is currently in chaos, feudal lords all rise, if the magistrate appoints generals poorly, one defeat and all lost.

units.zh: 蕭、曹等皆文吏，自愛，恐事不就，後秦種族其家，盡讓高祖。
units.en: Xiao, Cao, and the others were all civil officials who cherished themselves. They feared that if things didn't succeed, Qin would exterminate their families, so they all yielded to Emperor Gaozu.
units.literal: Xiao, Cao and others all were civil officials, cherished themselves, feared the matter would not succeed, afterward Qin would exterminate their families, all yielded to Gaozu.

units.zh: 高祖數讓。
units.en: Emperor Gaozu declined repeatedly.
units.literal: Gaozu repeatedly declined.

units.zh: 眾莫肯為，高祖乃立為沛公。
units.en: No one else was willing to take it, so Emperor Gaozu was established as Lord of Pei.
units.literal: The crowd none would do it, Gaozu then was established as Pei Gong.

units.zh: 十一月，沛公引兵之薛。
units.en: In the eleventh month, Pei Gong led troops to Xue.
units.literal: Eleventh month, Pei Gong led troops to Xi.

units.zh: 秦泗川守壯兵敗於薛，走至戚，沛公左司馬得殺之。
units.en: The Qin governor of Si River Zhuang was defeated at Xue and fled to Qi, where Pei Gong's left commander Sima De killed him.
units.literal: Qin Sishui defender Zhuang's troops defeated at Xue, fled to Qi, Pei Gong's left marshal captured and killed him.

units.zh: 沛公還軍亢父，至方與。
units.en: Pei Gong returned his army to Kangfu and arrived at Fang Yu.
units.literal: Pei Gong returned his army to Kang Fu, arrived at Fang Yu.

units.zh: 雍齒雅不欲屬沛公，及魏招之，即反為魏守豐。
units.en: Yong Chi had long not wanted to serve Pei Gong, and when Wei summoned him, he immediately rebelled and defended Feng for Wei.
units.literal: Yong Chi usually did not wish to belong to Pei Gong, when Wei summoned him, immediately rebelled to guard Feng for Wei.

units.zh: 沛公攻豐，不能取。
units.en: Pei Gong attacked Feng but could not capture it.
units.literal: Pei Gong attacked Feng, could not capture it.

units.zh: 沛公還之沛，怨雍齒與豐子弟畔之。
units.en: Pei Gong returned to Pei, resentful that Yong Chi and the young men of Feng had rebelled against him.
units.literal: Pei Gong returned to Pei, resented Yong Chi and the Feng youths rebelling against him.

units.zh: 沛公往從之，道得張良，遂與俱見景駒，請兵以攻豐。
units.en: Pei Gong went to join him, met Zhang Liang along the way, and together they went to see Jing Ju, requesting troops to attack Feng.
units.literal: Pei Gong went to follow them, on the road obtained Zhang Liang, then together went to see Jing Ju, requested troops to attack Feng.

units.zh: 東陽甯君、沛公引兵西，與戰蕭西，不利，還收兵聚留。
units.en: The Lord of Dongyang Ning and Pei Gong led troops west and battled west of Xiao, but were unsuccessful, so they retreated and gathered troops at Liu.
units.literal: Dongyang Ning Jun, Pei Gong led troops west, fought battle at Xiao west, unfavorable, returned gathered troops at Liu.

units.zh: 四月，項梁擊殺景駒、秦嘉，止薛，沛公往見之。
units.en: In the fourth month, Xiang Liang attacked and killed Jing Ju and Qin Jia, then stopped at Xue. Pei Gong went to see him.
units.literal: Fourth month, Xiang Liang attacked and killed Jing Ju, Qin Jia, stopped at Xue, Pei Gong went to see him.

units.zh: 項梁益沛公卒五千人，五大夫將十人。
units.en: Xiang Liang increased Pei Gong's troops by five thousand men and ten generals of the rank of Grand Master.
units.literal: Xiang Liang increased Pei Gong's troops five thousand, Grand Master generals ten people.

units.zh: 沛公還，引兵攻豐，拔之。
units.en: Pei Gong returned and led troops to attack Feng, capturing it.
units.literal: Pei Gong returned, led troops to attack Feng, captured it.

units.zh: 六月，沛公如薛，與項梁共立楚懷王孫心為楚懷王。
units.en: In the sixth month, Pei Gong went to Xue and together with Xiang Liang established Chu King Huai's grandson Xin as King Huai of Chu.
units.literal: Sixth month, Pei Gong went to Xue, together with Xiang Liang established Chu King Huai's grandson Xin as Chu King Huai.

units.zh: 沛公攻亢父。
units.en: Pei Gong attacked Kangfu.
units.literal: Pei Gong attacked Kang Fu.

units.zh: 沛公與項梁共救田榮，大破章邯東阿。
units.en: Pei Gong and Xiang Liang together went to rescue Tian Rong and greatly defeated Zhang Han at Dong'e.
units.literal: Pei Gong together with Xiang Liang rescued Tian Rong, greatly defeated Zhang Han at Dong'a.

units.zh: 田榮歸，沛公、項羽追北，至城陽，攻屠其城。
units.en: Tian Rong returned. Pei Gong and Xiang Yu pursued the defeated enemy north to Chengyang and attacked, massacring the population of the city.
units.literal: Tian Rong returned, Pei Gong, Xiang Yu pursued north, arrived at Chengyang, attacked and slaughtered its city.

units.zh: 沛公、項羽去攻定陶。
units.en: Pei Gong and Xiang Yu left to attack Dingtao.
units.literal: Pei Gong, Xiang Yu left to attack Dingtao.

units.zh: 定陶未下，沛公與項羽西略地至雍丘，與秦軍戰，大敗之，斬三川守李由。
units.en: Dingtao had not yet fallen. Pei Gong and Xiang Yu marched west to seize territory as far as Yongqiu, where they battled Qin troops and greatly defeated them, beheading the governor of Sanchuan, Li You.
units.literal: Dingtao not yet fallen, Pei Gong together with Xiang Yu west conquered territory to Yongqiu, fought with Qin army, greatly defeated them, beheaded Sanchuan defender Li You.

units.zh: 沛公、項羽方攻陳留，聞梁死，士卒恐，乃與將軍呂臣引兵而東，徙懷王自盱台都彭城。
units.en: Pei Gong and Xiang Yu were attacking Chenliu when they heard of Liang's death. The soldiers were terrified, so they joined with General Lü Chen and led troops east, moving King Huai from Xutai to Pengcheng as the capital.
units.literal: Pei Gong, Xiang Yu just attacking Chenliu, heard Liang died, soldiers afraid, then together with general Lu Chen led troops east, moved King Huai from Xutai capital to Pengcheng.

units.zh: 呂臣軍彭城東，項羽軍彭城西，沛公軍碭。
units.en: Lü Chen's army was stationed east of Pengcheng, Xiang Yu's army west of Pengcheng, and Pei Gong's army at Dang.
units.literal: Lu Chen's army east of Pengcheng, Xiang Yu's army west of Pengcheng, Pei Gong's army at Dang.

units.zh: 以沛公為碭郡長，封武安侯，將碭郡兵。
units.en: He appointed Pei Gong as governor of Dang commandery, enfeoffed him as Marquis of Wuan, and put him in command of Dang commandery troops.
units.literal: Made Pei Gong Dang commandery chief, sealed as Marquis of Wuan, led Dang commandery troops.

units.zh: 獨羽怨秦破項梁，奮勢，願與沛公西入關。
units.en: Only Xiang Yu resented Qin for defeating Xiang Liang and was eager to go west into the pass with Pei Gong.
units.literal: Only Yu resented Qin for defeating Xiang Liang, exerted his influence, wished to go west into the pass with Pei Gong.

units.zh: 項羽不可遣，獨沛公素寬大長者。」
units.en: Xiang Yu should not be sent. Only Pei Gong is habitually magnanimous and an elder."
units.literal: Xiang Yu cannot be sent, only Pei Gong is habitually magnanimous and elder.'

units.zh: 卒不許羽，而遣沛公西收陳王、項梁散卒。
units.en: In the end they did not permit Xiang Yu, but sent Pei Gong west to gather the scattered troops of King Chen and Xiang Liang.
units.literal: In the end did not permit Yu, instead sent Pei Gong west to gather King Chen, Xiang Liang's scattered troops.

units.zh: 沛公攻破東郡尉於成武。
units.en: Pei Gong attacked and defeated the Dong commandery commandant at Chengwu.
units.literal: Pei Gong attacked and defeated the Dongjun prefect at Chengwu.

units.zh: 十二月，沛公引兵至栗，遇剛武侯，奪其軍四千餘人，并之，與魏將皇欣、武滿軍合，攻秦軍，破之。
units.en: In the twelfth month, Pei Gong led troops to Li and encountered Gangwu Marquis, seized over four thousand of his men, and combined them. He joined with Wei generals Huang Xin and Wu Man's army and attacked Qin troops, defeating them.
units.literal: Twelfth month, Pei Gong led troops to Li, encountered Gangwu Marquis, seized his army more than four thousand people, merged them, combined with Wei generals Huang Xin, Wu Man armies, attacked Qin army, defeated it.

units.zh: 二月，沛公從碭北攻昌邑，遇彭越。
units.en: In the second month, Pei Gong from north of Dang attacked Changyi and encountered Peng Yue.
units.literal: Second month, Pei Gong from north of Dang attacked Changyi, encountered Peng Yue.

units.zh: 沛公西過高陽，酈食其為里監門，曰：「諸將過此者多，吾視沛公大度。」
units.en: Pei Gong passed west through Gaoyang. Li Yiji was the village gatekeeper and said: "Many generals have passed through here. I can see that Pei Gong has great magnanimity."
units.literal: Pei Gong west passed Gaoyang, Li Yiji was village gatekeeper, said: 'Various generals who passed this place many, I observe Pei Gong has great magnanimity.'

units.zh: 乃求見沛公。
units.en: So he sought to see Pei Gong.
units.literal: Then requested to see Pei Gong.

units.zh: 沛公方踞床，使兩女子洗。
units.en: Pei Gong was sitting cross-legged on a bed, having two women wash his feet.
units.literal: Pei Gong just then squatting on bed, made two women wash.

units.zh: 於是沛公起，攝衣謝之，延上坐。
units.en: So Pei Gong rose, straightened his clothes, and apologized. He invited him to sit in the honored position.
units.literal: Thereupon Pei Gong rose, gathered clothes thanked him, invited to upper seat.

units.zh: 食其說沛公襲陳留。
units.en: Yiji persuaded Pei Gong to attack Chenliu by surprise.
units.literal: Yiji persuaded Pei Gong to attack Chenliu by surprise.

units.zh: 沛公以為廣野君，以其弟商為將，將陳留兵。
units.en: Pei Gong made him Lord Guangye and appointed his younger brother Shang as general, commanding the Chenliu troops.
units.literal: Pei Gong made him Lord Guangye and appointed his younger brother Shang as general, commanding the Chenliu troops.

units.zh: 時趙別將司馬卬方欲渡河入關，沛公乃北攻平陰，絕河津。
units.en: At this time, Sima Ang, a separate Zhao general, was about to cross the Yellow River and enter the passes. Pei Gong therefore attacked Pingyin to the north and cut off the river crossings.
units.literal: At this time, the Zhao general Sima Ang was about to cross the river into the passes. Pei Gong attacked Beiyin to the north and cut off the river crossings.

units.zh: 沛公引兵過宛西。
units.en: Pei Gong led his troops west past Wan.
units.literal: Pei Gong led his troops west past Wan.

units.zh: 張良諫曰：「沛公雖欲急入關，秦兵尚眾，距險。
units.en: Zhang Liang advised: "Although Pei Gong wishes to rush into the passes, the Qin troops are still numerous and hold the dangerous passes.
units.literal: Zhang Liang advised: "Although Pei Gong wishes to rush into the passes, the Qin troops are still numerous and hold the dangerous passes.

units.zh: 沛公至霸上。
units.en: The Duke of Pei reached Bashang.
units.literal: The Duke of Pei reached Bashang.

units.zh: 諸將或言誅秦王，沛公曰：「始懷王遣我，固以能寬容，且人已服降，殺之不祥。」
units.en: Some of the generals said that the King of Qin should be executed. The Duke of Pei said, "When King Huai first sent me, it was precisely because I was able to be lenient. Moreover, the man has already submitted and surrendered; to kill him would be inauspicious."
units.literal: Some of the generals said to execute the King of Qin. The Duke of Pei said, "When King Huai first sent me, it was precisely because I was able to be lenient; moreover, the man has already submitted and surrendered, and to kill him would be inauspicious."

units.zh: 三月，漢王自臨晉渡河，魏王豹降，將兵從。
units.en: In the third month, King Han crossed the Yellow River from Linjin. King Wei Bao surrendered and led troops to follow him.
units.literal: In the third month, King Han crossed the Yellow River from Linjin. King Wei Bao surrendered and led troops to follow him.

units.zh: 南渡平陰津，至洛陽，新城三老董公遮說漢王曰：「臣聞『順德者昌，逆德者亡』，『兵出無名，事故不成』。
units.en: He crossed south at Pingyin Ford and reached Luoyang. Dong Gong, the elder of Xincheng, stopped the King of Han and advised him: "I have heard, 'Those who follow virtue prosper; those who oppose virtue perish,' and, 'When troops are sent out without a proper name, the enterprise will not succeed.'
units.literal: He crossed south at Pingyin ford and reached Luoyang. The elder of Xincheng, Dong Gong, blocked and advised King Han: "I have heard that 'those who follow virtue prosper, those who oppose virtue perish,' and 'when troops are sent out without just cause, affairs will not succeed.'

units.zh: 羽見紀信，問：「漢王安在？」
units.en: Xiang Yu saw Ji Xin and asked: "Where is King Han?"
units.literal: Xiang Yu saw Ji Xin and asked: "Where is King Han?"

units.zh: 漢王從之。
units.en: King Han followed their advice.
units.literal: King Han followed their advice.

units.zh: 吾與諸侯約，先入關者王之，吾當王關中。
units.en: I made an agreement with the feudal lords: whoever first entered the Pass would be king there, and I should be king in Guanzhong.
units.literal: I made an agreement with the feudal lords: whoever first entered the Pass would be king there, and I should be king in Guanzhong.

units.zh: 民又益喜，唯恐沛公不為秦王。
units.en: The people were even more delighted and feared only that the Duke of Pei would not become King of Qin.
units.literal: The people were even more delighted and feared only that the Duke of Pei would not become King of Qin.

units.zh: 背約，更立沛公為漢王，王巴、蜀、漢中四十一縣，都南鄭。
units.en: Breaking the agreement, he further established Pei Gong as King of Han, ruling Ba, Shu, Hanzhong, and 41 counties, with capital at Nanzheng.
units.literal: Breaking the agreement, he further established Pei Gong as King of Han, ruling Ba, Shu, Hanzhong, and 41 counties, with capital at Nanzheng.

units.zh: 漢王怨羽之背約，欲攻之，丞相蕭何諫，乃止。
units.en: King Han resented Xiang Yu for breaking the agreement and wanted to attack him. Chancellor Xiao He advised against it, so he stopped.
units.literal: King Han resented Xiang Yu for breaking the agreement and wanted to attack him. Chancellor Xiao He advised against it, so he stopped.

units.zh: 漢王曰：「善，非夫子無所聞。」
units.en: King Han said: "Excellent. Were it not for you, sir, I would have heard nothing of this."
units.literal: King Han said: "Excellent. Were it not for you, sir, I would have heard nothing of this."

units.zh: 及壯，試吏，為泗上亭長，廷中吏無所不狎侮。
units.en: When he reached adulthood, he tried serving as an official and became pavilion chief of Sishang. Among the officials at court there was none he did not treat with familiar disrespect.
units.literal: When he reached adulthood, he tried serving as an official, became the pavilion chief of Sishang, and among the officials in the court there was none he did not treat with familiarity and insult.

units.zh: 沛公然其計，從之。
units.en: Pei Gong approved this plan and followed it.
units.literal: Pei Gong approved this plan and followed it.

units.zh: 五月，漢王引兵從故道出襲雍。
units.en: In the fifth month, King Han led troops from the old road to attack Yong by surprise.
units.literal: In the fifth month, King Han led troops from the old road to attack Yong by surprise.

units.zh: 漢王出滎陽，至成皋。
units.en: King Han left Xingyang and reached Chenggao.
units.literal: King Han left Xingyang and reached Chenggao.

units.zh: 母媼嘗息大澤之陂，夢與神遇。
units.en: Once, while resting by the dike of a vast marsh, his mother dreamed that she encountered a divine being.
units.literal: His mother the old woman once rested by the dike of the great marsh, and dreamed of encountering a god.

units.zh: 是時雷電晦冥，父太公往視，則見交龍於上。
units.en: At that moment, thunder crashed and darkness fell. His father, Taigong, went to investigate and saw two dragons entwined in the sky above.
units.literal: At this time thunder and lightning were dark and obscure, father Taigong went to look, then saw two dragons entwining above.

units.zh: 呂公女即呂后也，生孝惠帝、魯元公主。
units.en: This daughter of Lü Gong would become Empress Lü. She gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.
units.literal: Lü Gong's daughter was namely Empress Lü, gave birth to Emperor Xiaohui and Princess Lu Yuan.

units.zh: 呂后與兩子居田中，有一老父過請飲，呂后因餔之。
units.en: Empress Lü lived in the countryside with their two children. An old man passed by and asked for a drink. Empress Lü fed him.
units.literal: Empress Lü and the two children resided in the fields, there was an old father who passed by requesting drink, Empress Lü because of this fed him.

units.zh: 老子曰：「其政察察，其人缺缺。」
units.en: Laozi said, "When government is excessively exacting, the people grow impoverished in spirit."
units.literal: Laozi said: "When government is minutely scrutinizing, the people are deficient and incomplete."

units.zh: 又曰：「法令滋章，盜賊多有。」
units.en: He also said, "When laws and statutes proliferate, thieves and bandits multiply."
units.literal: He also said: "When laws and decrees multiply, robbers and bandits abound."

units.zh: 邦內傷心，有識悲悼，咸以吳國夫差復存，先帝親賢，陛下反之，是陛下不遵先帝二也；
units.en: The whole court grieved; men said King Fuchai of Wu had come again. The late emperor cherished worth; you do the opposite—this is the second way you abandon his model;
units.literal: Within the state hearts were wounded, those with understanding mourned in grief; all thought that Wu's Fuchai had returned to life; the late emperor honored the worthy—Your Majesty does the opposite: this is the second instance of Your Majesty's not following the late emperor;

units.zh: 與梁人泛言氏族，袁狎曰：「未若我本出自黃帝，姓在十四之限。」
units.en: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said, "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."
units.literal: With the men of Liang he spoke at large on clans; Yuan Xia said: "Still not as good as my house — we issue from the Yellow Emperor and our surname stands within the fourteen."

units.zh: 李渾 子湛 渾弟繪 族子公緒 李璵 弟瑾 族弟曉 鄭述祖 子元德
units.en: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande
units.literal: Li Hun; his son Zhan; Hun's brother Hui; clansman Gongxu; Li Yu; brother Jin; clansman Xiao; Zheng Shuzu; son Yuande

units.zh: 胡廣說曰：「趙武靈王效胡服，以金璫飾首，前插貂尾，爲貴職。
units.en: Hu Guang explained: “King Wuling of Zhao copied Hu dress, using a gold knob to ornament the head, sable tails inserted in front, for exalted offices.
units.literal: Hu Guang explained: “King Wuling of Zhao copied Hu dress, using a gold knob to ornament the head, sable tails inserted in front, for exalted offices.

units.zh: 術氏冠，前圓，吳制，差池邐迤四重，趙武靈王好服之。
units.en: The Shi-style round Wu cap, tiered in four rippling layers, was a favorite of King Wuling of Zhao.
units.literal: The Shi clan cap is round in front, a Wu style, rippling in four layers; King Wuling of Zhao loved to wear it.

units.zh: 鶡者，勇雉也，其鬥對一死乃止，故趙武靈王以表武士，秦施之焉。
units.en: The fighting cock-pheasant dies rather than yield, so Zhao’s martial king and later Qin used its plumes to brand elite troops.
units.literal: The he is a courageous pheasant; in combat they face each other until one dies; therefore King Wuling of Zhao displayed warriors with it, and Qin applied it.

units.zh: 至說世祖云：「自古帝王，盡為灰燼，堯、舜、桀、紂，竟復何異？
units.en: He even told Shizu, "Every emperor since antiquity ends as ashes—what difference between Yao, Shun, Jie, and Zhou?
units.literal: He even told Shizu, "Emperors from ancient times have all turned to ash—what difference in the end between Yao, Shun, Jie, and Zhou?

units.zh: 侍中、中常侍加黃金璫，附蟬爲文，貂尾爲飾，謂之「趙惠文冠」。
units.en: Palace attendants gilded the cap with a front cicada plaque and sable tail—hence the nickname “Marquis Huiwen crown.”
units.literal: Palace attendants and regular palace attendants add a gold knob, cicada pattern in front, and sable tail as ornament; it is called the “Marquis Huiwen cap.”

units.zh: 穰侯，昭王之舅也，權重於秦，威震鄰敵，有旦莫偃伏之愛，心不介然有間，然范雎起徒步，由異國，無雅信，開一朝之說，而穰侯就封。
units.en: Marquis Rang, uncle to King Zhao of Qin, dominated that state and awed its neighbors; he shared the king's pillow and board without a shadow between them—yet Fan Ju, a stranger on foot, won a single hearing and sent Rang packing to his domain.
units.literal: Marquis Rang was King Zhao of Qin maternal uncle; his weight of power was in Qin, his awesomeness shook neighboring enemies; he had morning-and-evening couch-bending love, his mind was not stuck with a gap—yet Fan Ju rose from walking the roads, came from a different state, had no long-standing trust, opened one morning persuasion, and Marquis Rang went to his fief.

units.zh: 昕曰：「箕子為之奴，何言無也？」
units.en: Xin said, "Jizi became a slave—how say there were none?"
units.literal: Xin said: "Jizi became a slave—how say there were none?"

units.zh: 楚昭王遭闔廬之禍，國滅出亡，父老送之。
units.en: Even after catastrophic defeat under Wu pressure, King Zhao entered exile with popular support.
units.literal: King Zhao of Chu suffered the disaster of Helu; his state was destroyed and he fled in exile, with elders seeing him off.

units.zh: 燕王喜走遼東，翦遂定燕薊而還。
units.en: King Xi of Yan fled to Liaodong. Jian thereupon pacified Yan's Ji and returned.
units.literal: King Xi of Yan fled to Liaodong. Jian then pacified Yan's Ji and returned.

units.zh: 明年，燕使荊軻為賊於秦，秦王使王翦攻燕。
units.en: The following year, Yan sent Jing Ke to assassinate Qin. The King of Qin sent Wang Jian to attack Yan.
units.literal: The next year, Yan sent Jing Ke to assassinate Qin. The King of Qin sent Wang Jian to attack Yan.

units.zh: 樂乘破卿秦於代。
units.en: Yue Cheng defeated Qing Qin at Dai.
units.literal: Yue Cheng defeated Qing Qin at Dai.

units.zh: 使樂乘代廉頗，廉頗不聽，攻樂乘，樂乘走，廉頗奔大梁。
units.en: They sent Yue Cheng to replace Lian Po. Lian Po did not obey and attacked Yue Cheng. Yue Cheng fled, and Lian Po fled to the city of Daliang.
units.literal: They sent Yue Cheng to replace Lian Po. Lian Po did not obey, attacked Yue Cheng. Yue Cheng fled, and Lian Po fled to Daliang.

units.zh: 今王喜四年，秦昭王卒。
units.en: In the fourth year of the present king Xi's reign, King Zhao of Qin died.
units.literal: In the present king Xi's fourth year, King Zhao of Qin died.

units.zh: 十年，趙使廉頗將攻繁陽，拔之。
units.en: In the tenth year, Zhao sent Lian Po as general to attack Fanyang, and he captured it.
units.literal: In the tenth year, Zhao sent Lian Po as general to attack Fanyang and captured it.

units.zh: 僕有三罪，而欲求活，此伍子胥所以僨於吳世也。
units.en: With three crimes of my own, to seek life would be like Wu Zixu's downfall in Wu.
units.literal: With three crimes of my own, to seek life would be like Wu Zixu's ruin in Wu.

units.zh: 昔樂毅為燕昭王立功於齊，惠王即位，疑奪其任，遂去燕之趙，休烈不虧。
units.en: Once Yue Yi served King Zhao of Yan against Qi; when King Hui came to the throne he was suspected and stripped of command, left Yan for Zhao, and lost none of his renown.
units.literal: Formerly Yue Yi for King Zhao of Yan achieved merit in Qi; when King Hui ascended, suspecting him he removed his charge, whereupon he left Yan for Zhao—his splendid fame undiminished.

units.zh: 是以聖王覺寤，捐子之之心，而能不說於田常之賢；
units.en: This is why the sage kings, upon awakening, cast aside partiality toward their own kin and refused to be swayed by the schemes of a Tian Chang.
units.literal: Therefore, the sage kings, upon awakening, cast aside the heart that favors one's own kin, and would not be swayed by the schemes of a Tian Chang;

units.zh: 是時，李悝為魏文侯作盡地力之教，以為地方百里，提封九萬頃，除山澤邑居參分去一，為田六百萬畝，治田勤謹則畝益三升，不勤則損亦如之。
units.en: Serving Marquis Wen of Wei, Li Kui devised a program that quantified agricultural gains from more intensive cultivation within a calibrated assessment of available land.
units.literal: Then Li Kui for Marquis Wen of Wei made teachings of exhausting land power: in a hundred-li square domain with ninety-thousand qing under seal, subtracting mountains, marshes, and settlements by one-third leaves six million mu; diligent cultivation adds three sheng per mu, negligence loses the same.

units.zh: 世祖下詔曰：「武王克殷，表商容之閭，閎修善謹敕，兵起，吏民獨不爭其頭首。
units.en: Emperor Guangwu decreed: "King Wu of Zhou honored Shang Rong's lane after conquering Shang; Wang Hong lived prudently and well, so that when rebellion broke out no mob tried to kill him for sport.
units.literal: Shizu issued an edict saying: "When King Wu conquered Yin, he marked Shang Rong's lane; Hong cultivated goodness and was restrained; when armies rose, clerks and people alone did not vie to take his head.

units.zh: 趙孝成王與平陽君、平原君計之。
units.en: King Xiaocheng of Zhao took counsel with Lord Pingyang and Lord Pingyuan.
units.literal: King Xiaocheng of Zhao consulted with Lord Pingyang and Lord Pingyuan.

units.zh: 四十五年，伐韓之野王。
units.en: In the forty-fifth year, he attacked Yewang in Han.
units.literal: In the forty-fifth year, he attacked Han's Yewang.

units.zh: 趙受之，因封馮亭為華陽君。
units.en: Zhao accepted the offer and enfeoffed Feng Ting as Lord Huayang.
units.literal: Zhao accepted it and enfeoffed Feng Ting as Lord Huayang.

units.zh: 趙王數以為讓。
units.en: The King of Zhao repeatedly reproached him for it.
units.literal: The King of Zhao repeatedly rebuked him for it.

units.zh: 趙王既怒廉頗軍多失亡，軍數敗，又反堅壁不敢戰，而又聞秦反閒之言，因使趙括代廉頗將以擊秦。
units.en: The King of Zhao was already furious that Lian Po's army had suffered heavy casualties and been defeated repeatedly. Moreover, he maintained a defensive wall and dared not fight, and he also heard the rumors sown by Qin's dissension. Therefore, he sent Zhao Kuo to replace Lian Po and attack Qin.
units.literal: The King of Zhao was already angry that Lian Po's army had suffered many losses and been defeated several times. Moreover, he heard the rumors of Qin's dissension. So he sent Zhao Kuo to replace Lian Po and attack Qin.

units.zh: 吾兄欽賢重士，敬愛忘疲，先築郭隗之宮，常置穆生之醴。
units.en: My elder brother cherishes the worthy and esteems scholars, honoring them without weariness; he first built a palace for Guo Kui and always kept the wine of Mu Sheng ready.
units.literal: My elder brother cherishes the worthy and esteems scholars, honoring and loving them without weariness; he first built a palace for Guo Kui and always kept the wine of Mu Sheng ready.

units.zh: 法雄字文彊，扶風郿人也，齊襄王法章之後。
units.en: Fa Xiong, styled Wenqiang, was a native of Mei in Fufeng and traced his line to Fa Zhang, King Xiang of Qi.
units.literal: Fa Xiong, courtesy name Wenqiang, was a man of Mei in Fufeng, a descendant of Fa Zhang, King Xiang of Qi.

units.zh: 張晏曰：「老子玄默，仲尼所師，雖不在聖，要為大賢，文伯之母達於禮典，動為聖人所歎，言為後世所則，而在第四。田單以即墨孤城復強齊之大，魯連之博通，忽於榮利，藺子申威秦王，退讓廉頗，乃在第五。大姬巫怪，好祭鬼神，陳人化之，國多淫祀，寺人孟子違於大雅，以保其身，旣被宮刑，怨刺而作，乃在第三。嫪毐上烝，昬亂禮度，惡不忍聞，乃在第七。其餘差違紛錯不少，略舉揚較，以起失謬。獨馳騖於數千歲之中，旁觀諸子，事業未究，而尋遇竇氏之難，使之然乎？」
units.en: Zhang Yan said, "Laozi was deep and silent, and Confucius regarded him as a teacher. Though not ranked among sages, he surely counts as a great worthy. Wenbo's mother mastered the ritual classics; the sage praised her conduct and later ages took her words as a model—yet she appears in the fourth grade. Tian Dan restored great Qi from the isolated city of Jimo; Lu Lian was broadly learned yet disdained fame and profit; Lord Lin awed the King of Qin and yielded to Lian Po—yet they are placed in the fifth grade. Great Ji practiced sorcery and loved sacrificing to ghosts and spirits; the people of Chen were transformed by her and the state was full of improper cults. The eunuch Mengzi, turning from the great elegant style to preserve himself—after castration, wrote in resentment—yet is placed in the third grade. Lao Ai committed incest at court and threw ritual order into chaos, in deeds too foul to bear hearing—yet he is placed in the seventh grade. Discrepancies and errors are many; I have cited a few to expose the faults. Did he gallop alone across thousands of years, looking on at the various masters while his work remained unfinished, then soon meet the Dou family's disaster—and did that make it turn out this way?"
units.literal: Zhang Yan said: "Laozi was profound and reticent, and Confucius took him as teacher. Though not among the sages, he ought to count as a great worthy. The mother of Wenbo was versed in ritual classics; her conduct won the sage's praise and her words became a model for later ages—yet she is placed in the fourth grade. Tian Dan restored mighty Qi from the lone fortress of Jimo; Lu Lian was broadly learned yet scorned glory and gain; Lord Lin intimidated the King of Qin and yielded ground to Lian Po—yet they are placed in the fifth grade. Great Ji practiced witchcraft and delighted in sacrificing to ghosts and spirits; the people of Chen were transformed by her and the state abounded in licentious worship. The eunuch Mengzi, departing from great elegance to preserve his person—after suffering castration, wrote in resentment and censure—yet is placed in the third grade. Lao Ai committed incest with the sovereign, befouling ritual norms in ways too vile to endure hearing—yet he is placed in the seventh grade. Other discrepancies and errors are numerous; I have raised a few for comparison to expose the mistakes. Did he rush alone through thousands of years, observing the various masters while his work remained incomplete, then soon encounter the Dou family's calamity—which made it come out this way?"

units.zh: 魏公子無忌者，魏昭王子少子而魏安釐王異母弟也。
units.en: Lord Xinling Wuji was the youngest son of King Zhao of Wei and the half-brother of King Anli of Wei.
units.literal: Lord Xinling Wuji was King Zhao of Wei's youngest son and King Anli's half-brother.

units.zh: 昭王薨，安釐王即位，封公子為信陵君。
units.en: When King Zhao died and King Anli ascended the throne, he enfeoffed the prince as Lord Xinling.
units.literal: After King Zhao died, King Anli ascended the throne and enfeoffed the prince as Lord Xinling.

units.zh: 燕王命相栗腹約歡趙，以五百金為趙王酒。
units.en: The Yan king ordered the prime minister Li Fu to make an alliance with Zhao, using five hundred pieces of gold to buy wine for the King of Zhao.
units.literal: The Yan king ordered the prime minister Li Fu to make an alliance with Zhao, using five hundred pieces of gold for the King of Zhao's wine.

units.zh: 卒起二軍，車二千乘，栗腹將而攻鄗，卿秦攻代。
units.en: He finally raised two armies with two thousand chariots. Li Fu led one and attacked Hao, while Qing Qin attacked Dai.
units.literal: He finally raised two armies with two thousand chariots. Li Fu led and attacked Hao, while Qing Qin attacked Dai.

units.zh: 燕軍至宋子，趙使廉頗將，擊破栗腹於鄗。
units.en: The Yan army reached Songzi. Zhao sent Lian Po as general, and he attacked and defeated Li Fu at Hao.
units.literal: The Yan army reached Songzi. Zhao sent Lian Po as general, who attacked and defeated Li Fu at Hao.

units.zh: 還報燕王曰：「趙王壯者皆死長平，其孤未壯，可伐也。」
units.en: He returned and reported to the Yan king, saying, “Zhao’s strong men all died at Changping. Their orphans are not yet grown. We can attack them.”
units.literal: He returned and reported to the Yan king, saying: "Zhao's strong men all died at Changping. Their orphans are not yet grown. We can attack them."

units.zh: 及即位，疑毅，使騎劫代將。
units.en: After he came to the throne, he distrusted Yue Yi and sent Qi Jie to replace him in command.
units.literal: When he came to the throne, he suspected Yi and sent Qi Jie to replace him as commander.

units.zh: 齊田單以即墨擊敗燕軍，騎劫死，燕兵引歸，齊悉復得其故城。
units.en: Tian Dan of Qi used Jimo as his base to defeat the Yan army. Qi Jie died, the Yan troops withdrew, and Qi recovered all its former cities.
units.literal: Tian Dan of Qi, using Jimo, struck and defeated the Yan army; Qi Jie died, the Yan troops withdrew and returned, and Qi recovered all its former cities.

units.zh: 十二月，詔曰：「秦皇帝、楚隱王、魏安釐王、齊愍王、趙悼襄王皆絕亡後。
units.en: In the twelfth month, the edict said: "The First Emperor of Qin, King Yin of Chu, King Anli of Wei, King Min of Qi, and King Daoxiang of Zhao all have lineages without descendants.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, the edict said: "The Qin First Emperor, Chu Yin King, Wei Anli King, Qi Min King, Zhao Dao Xiang King all have extinct lineages.

units.zh: 聞膠西有蓋公，善治黃老言，使人厚幣請之。
units.en: He heard that in Jiaoxi there was Master Gai, skilled in Huang-Lao teachings, and sent someone with generous gifts to invite him.
units.literal: He heard that in Jiaoxi there was Master Gai, skilled in Huang-Lao teachings, and sent someone with generous gifts to invite him.

units.zh: 既見蓋公，蓋公爲言治道貴清靜而民自定，推此類具言之。
units.en: When Cao Shen met Master Gai, the scholar explained that government should prize purity and tranquility, allowing the people to settle themselves, and developed the principle in detail.
units.literal: Once he met Master Gai, Master Gai explained that the art of government prized purity and tranquility, through which the people would settle themselves, and elaborated fully on this principle.

units.zh: 參於是避正堂，舍蓋公焉。
units.en: Cao Shen then yielded the main hall and lodged Master Gai there.
units.literal: Can then yielded the main hall and lodged Master Gai there.

units.zh: 通善齊人安期生，安期生嘗干項羽，項羽不能用其筴。
units.en: Tong was on good terms with An Qisheng, a man of Qi. An Qisheng once offered his counsel to Xiang Yu, but Xiang Yu proved unable to make use of his stratagems.
units.literal: Tong was friendly with the Qi man An Qisheng. An Qisheng once petitioned Xiang Yu, but Xiang Yu could not use his strategies.

units.zh: 已而項羽欲封此兩人，兩人終不肯受，亡去。
units.en: Later, Xiang Yu wished to enfeoff both men, but they refused to accept and disappeared.
units.literal: Afterward, Xiang Yu wished to enfeoff these two men, but they finally were unwilling to receive it and fled away.
